descriptions.w3d_runtime_create_service: Creates the retained runtime service using owner configuration.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_release_service: Stops and releases the runtime service.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_toggle: Forwards a toggle request to the runtime service.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_handle_message: Updates runtime flags for stop and service-toggle messages.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_finish: Forwards a completion request to the runtime service.
